service.name: Eden Raids (Savage)
service.longDescription: In the light-swallowed emptiness of the First, the memories of primals past take shape once more. To restore the flow of the elements, you must face Eden’s recreations one by one — and the promise that waits at the journey’s end.

rewards.title: Savage Gear
rewards.text: Savage gear ranging from ilvl 470 to 535 depending on the tier (various weapon types).

rewards.title: Exclusive Glamour & Minion Drops
rewards.text: Exclusive glamour and collectibles from the savage fights.

rewards.title: Achievement: “Savage Paradise Within Thee I” & More
rewards.text: Achievement unlocked upon defeating Shadowbringers Savage Tier.
